title: Common standards for asylum reception
subtitle: Final adoption by qualified majority
voteRuleLabel: Qualified majority (55% of states, 65% of population)
summary: Ministers adopted binding minimum standards for asylum reception — housing, healthcare and access to work after six months — over the objections of five member states. Italy, Latvia and Lithuania abstained, leaving the opposition short of a blocking minority.
whatItMeans: Reception standards apply from the day of arrival, not from registration.
Access to the labour market opens after six months instead of nine.
Compliance is monitored by the asylum agency, with reporting from 2028.

outcome.headline: Adopted — five against, three abstentions, no blocking minority.
